# load data (FULL CE)
```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
all.cea=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/FULL_cea_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]
names(all.cea)[1]="subjectID"
all.acc=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_acc_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
names(all.acc)[1]="subjectID"

all.optdev=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/full_optdev_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]

all.mlu=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/mlu_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]

all.sdt=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/FULL_sdt_agg_metrics_outlierremoved.csv"))[,-1]
all.sdt <- all.sdt %>%
  dplyr::select("Participant","dprime","c","condition")
names(all.sdt)[1]="subjectID"
#all.sdt.agg.v.all=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/within_sdt_byvideo_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]
```

```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE}
all=full_join(all.cea,all.acc,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.sdt,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.optdev,by=c("subjectID","condition"))
all=full_join(all,all.mlu,by=c("subjectID","condition"))


```

# outlier summary
```{r}
with_NA <- all[!complete.cases(all), ] #23 participant
num_NA <- sum(is.na(with_NA)) #29 datapoints

check=with_NA %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total=n())

outlier_summary <- with_NA %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(-c(subjectID,cr,hit), ~ sum(is.na(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r}

  colwidths = c(1, n_condition_cols)
)

  align(part = "all", align = "center") %>%
```

#full CE

##T-test
```{r,echo=FALSE}


#test assumptions for t-test
with(all, shapiro.test(dprime[condition == "WithLabel"]))# p = 0.63
with(all, shapiro.test(dprime[condition == "NoLabel"])) # p = 0.98
#both normally distributed
```

```{r}
res.ftest <- var.test(dprime ~ condition, data = all)
res.ftest #p=0.02121
#difference between variance
```

```{r}
with(all, shapiro.test(c[condition == "WithLabel"]))# p = 0.03
with(all, shapiro.test(c[condition == "NoLabel"])) # p = 0.09603
#label group not normally distributed
```

```{r}
res.ftest <- var.test(c ~ condition, data = all)
res.ftest #p=0.49
#no difference between variance


```

### CEA
```{r,echo=FALSE}
t.test(CEA_ave~condition,alternative="two.sided",data=all)
#with label, people are less sensitive (lower dprime)
#also note that with label, there's overall fewer number of CE than no label condition
```

### effect size
```{r}
cohensD(CEA_ave~condition,data=all) 

```






### dprime
```{r,echo=FALSE}
t.test(dprime~condition,alternative="two.sided",data=all)
#with label, people are less sensitive (lower dprime)
#also note that with label, there's overall fewer number of CE than no label condition
```

### effect size
```{r}
cohensD(dprime~condition,data=all) #effect size of 0.72 (moderate), power sufficient to be detected

```



### c
```{r,echo=FALSE}
t.test(c~condition,alternative="two.sided",data=all)

```


##visual

```{r}

# all$condition <- factor(
#   all$condition,
#   levels = c("NoLabel", "WithLabel")
# )


make_boxplot <- function(
    data,
    variable,
    title,
    comparisons = NULL,
    annotations = NULL
) {
  
  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = condition,
      y = .data[[variable]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = condition)) +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(
      color = "black",
      size = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 12, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = ""
    )
  
  if (!is.null(comparisons)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_signif(
        comparisons = comparisons,
        annotations = annotations,
        map_signif_level = FALSE,
        margin_top = 0.05,
        tip_length = 0.01,
        textsize = 5
      )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```


```{r}
label_comparison <- list(
  c("NoLabel", "WithLabel")
)


# 1. sensitivity, and response bias


p_sensitivity <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "dprime",
  title = "Sensitivity by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)

p_criterion <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "c",
  title = "Response bias by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)

p_performance <-  p_sensitivity + p_criterion

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/sensitivity_bias.pdf",
  plot = p_performance,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# 2. Accuracy & Consensus Event Agreement

p_accuracy <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "accuracy",
  title = "Accuracy by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)


p_CEA <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "CEA_ave",
  title = "Consensus Event Agreement by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)

p_accCEA <- p_accuracy + p_CEA


ggsave(
  filename = "visual/CEA_accuracy_boxplot.pdf",
  plot = p_accCEA,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)


# 3. Segmentation number and mean length unit
p_segnum <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "SegNum_ave",
  title = "Segmentation Number by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)

p_MLU <- make_boxplot(
  all,
  variable = "MLU_ave",
  title = "Mean length unit by condition",
  comparisons = label_comparison,
  annotations = "***"
)

p_segmentation <- p_segnum + p_MLU

ggsave(
  filename = "visual/segnum_MLU.pdf",
  plot = p_segmentation,
  width = 10,
  height = 5
)
```

```{r}
names(within.acc)[1]="subjectID"

within.optdev=(read.csv("Processed Data/Level2_output/within_optdev_outremoved.csv"))[,-1]

all=full_join(within.sdt,within.cea)
all=full_join(all,within.acc)
all=full_join(all,within.optdev)
all=full_join(all,within.mlu)


```

# outlier summary
```{r}
with_NA <- all[!complete.cases(all), ] #34 participant
num_NA <- sum(is.na(with_NA)) #44 datapoints

check=with_NA %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(total=n())

outlier_summary <- with_NA %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(-c(subjectID,cr,hit), ~ sum(is.na(.x)), .names = "{.col}")) %>%
  ungroup()


```

##descipritve - visual
```{r}
df_fmt <- desc %>%
  mutate(
    value = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean, sd)
  ) %>%
  select(condition, metric, value)
```

```{r}
table_df <- df_fmt %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric)
```

```{r}
#apa style table

ft <- flextable(table_df)

ft <- set_header_labels(ft, metric = "Measure")

n_total_cols <- ncol(table_df)  
n_condition_cols <- n_total_cols - 1

ft <- add_header_row(
  ft,
  values = c("Measure", "Condition"),
  colwidths = c(1, n_condition_cols)
)

ft <- ft %>%
  align(part = "all", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = 1, part = "body", align = "left") %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs() %>%
  autofit()

ft
```
##Ttest
```{r,echo=FALSE}

#test assumptions for t-test
with(all, shapiro.test(dprime[condition == "WithLabel"]))
with(all, shapiro.test(dprime[condition == "NoLabel"])) 
#both normally distributed
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
res.ftest <- var.test(dprime ~ condition, data = all)
res.ftest #p=0.02
#difference between variance

with(all, shapiro.test(c[condition == "WithLabel"]))#
with(all, shapiro.test(c[condition == "NoLabel"]))
#label condition not normally distributed
res.ftest <- var.test(c ~ condition, data = all)
res.ftest #p=0.90
#no difference between variance

#we do u test for c given it's not normally distributed

wilcox.test(c~ condition, data = all, exact = FALSE)
#two conditions still significantly different
```
